one_liner: A federal contracting job for the St. Lawrence Seaway agency: you plan purchases, write solicitations, analyze prices, negotiate, and manage contracts through closeout under the FAR.
fit_summary: This job needs a year of hands-on contracting work (market research, solicitations, price analysis, negotiation, contract administration) or a relevant master's degree. Daniel's IEM work gives him contractor-side versions of some of it (screening SAM.gov opportunities, writing proposals, buying medical supplies), but it's unclear whether HR will count his M.A. in Global Affairs as relevant, so GS-9 is a stretch worth trying.
eligibility: Open to U.S. citizens and nationals through Direct Hire (public and fed-transition paths), so no federal status or veterans' preference is needed.
Mandatory education for the 1102 series: a bachelor's degree in any field OR 24 semester hours in accounting, business, finance, law, economics, or a similar field. Transcripts are required.

GS-09 requires one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-07 performing pre-award and post-award contracting functions. As an alternative, you can qualify with a master's degree or 2 years of graduate study in a listed field such as business, law, or economics.
GS-11 requires one year of experience equivalent to GS-09, independently handling contracting across methods and contract types, or Ph.D.-level graduate education.
You must pass a background investigation and accept a government travel card for required travel. Males born after 12/31/1959 must be registered with Selective Service.
strategy: List the IEM duties that touch acquisition: screening SAM.gov, GovWin and DHS forecast opportunities, leading proposal writing, and procuring and tracking medical supplies for six states. Pricing, task orders, subcontracts and modifications aren't on his resume, so claim only what he did.

Apply at GS-09 only. Write a two-page resume where each relevant job lists title, MM/YYYY dates, and hours per week, then describes the contracting tasks he performed in his own words, using the posting's key terms where they fit.

Make sure the questionnaire narratives match your resume line by line. Begin each one with title, organization, dates, full- or part-time status, and weekly hours, because HR disqualifies claims the resume doesn't support.
Upload your transcripts by the closing date, 11:59 PM EST on 12/31/2026. Apply well before the holidays, since a missing transcript means automatic ineligibility.

If you don't yet qualify, treat this as a target role. Look into DAU or FAC-C coursework, or entry-level GS-05/07 1102 roles, contract-specialist trainee programs, or Virginia state procurement (VCA) jobs, and build a year of qualifying experience.
resume_bullets: Found multimillion-dollar opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin, BidPro and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing in answer to government solicitations (2019–2024).
As part of the logistics team, procured medical supplies, equipment and vaccines for sites in six states and set up vendor relationships (2021–2022).
Tracked orders and spending in Excel pivot-table reports for the logistics team.
interview_questions: Walk us through how you would take a requirements package from a program office to a solicitation.
How do you determine price reasonableness when only one offer is received?
Describe a negotiation where you had to resolve differences on price, schedule, or terms.
When would you choose a time-and-materials contract over firm-fixed-price, and what FAR limitations apply?
watch_outs: Consulting work done on behalf of a contractor qualifies only if it involved actual contracting functions; general emergency-management project work will likely be rated ineligible.
Only two pages of your resume are reviewed, and cover letters and links are ignored, so put the specialized experience up front.
The location is listed as 'Multiple Locations' and the job is telework-eligible but not remote. Confirm whether there is a duty station near Manassas or the DC area, and expect some travel.
